# Level Up artwork

The user selected **28 · Framed Icon + Text** from the asset comparison, with the current-level caption centered below the Level Up! heading. The native class icon sits inside an ornamental square gold frame. A small round waiting-count badge overlaps the upper-right. The complete icon/text group centers inside its edit box. A translucent black backdrop with feathered edges and a pulsing gold halo improve visibility. Text remains live and uses the game's DEFAULT font.

## Gold frame source

- [NeticSoul/DragonUI, commit 6d9cc95eedd1de78fab3b965683df13421e21604](https://github.com/NeticSoul/DragonUI/tree/6d9cc95eedd1de78fab3b965683df13421e21604).
- Exact file: [`DragonUI/Textures/Collections/IconFrameGold.tga`](https://github.com/NeticSoul/DragonUI/blob/6d9cc95eedd1de78fab3b965683df13421e21604/DragonUI/Textures/Collections/IconFrameGold.tga), a 128-by-128 uncompressed RGBA TGA. The full canvas is copied byte-for-byte, retaining its colors and transparency; no source crop or format conversion is applied.
- The source's [third-party notices](https://github.com/NeticSoul/DragonUI/blob/6d9cc95eedd1de78fab3b965683df13421e21604/DragonUI/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) identify this isolated image as a cut and resample from DragonflightUI's Spellbook-Parts sheet. The upstream file is [`Textures/UI/Spellbook-Parts.blp`](https://github.com/Karl-HeinzSchneider/WoW-DragonflightUI/blob/f59cbc3f7010ef692fb983c7c3c848c4b70f56ce/Textures/UI/Spellbook-Parts.blp). The implementation uses the verified isolated TGA rather than guessing coordinates on that upstream sheet. Repository family names do not establish an exact retail client build for these pixels.
- Source software notices: [MIT, NeticSoul and DragonUI contributors, 2026](https://github.com/NeticSoul/DragonUI/blob/6d9cc95eedd1de78fab3b965683df13421e21604/LICENSE), and [MIT, Karl-HeinzSchneider, 2022](https://github.com/Karl-HeinzSchneider/WoW-DragonflightUI/blob/f59cbc3f7010ef692fb983c7c3c848c4b70f56ce/LICENSE). The applicable notices are retained in shipped `modules/ui/levels.lua` comments.

Underlying World of Warcraft artwork remains copyright Blizzard Entertainment. The repositories' software licenses do not relicense Blizzard artwork. No source-addon Lua, framework, font or runtime dependency is imported.

## Assembly and preparation

`scripts/prepare_levelup_art.py --source /path/to/IconFrameGold.tga` copies the source into `media/tex/levelup/IconFrameGold.tga`. It also draws `CountBadge.tga`, an original gold disk with a muted brown rim and transparent outer corners, at four times the output resolution before downsampling to a 64-by-64 uncompressed RGBA TGA. `Backdrop.tga` and `Glow.tga` are original 512-by-128 uncompressed RGBA textures, calculated from a rounded rectangle's signed distance. The black backdrop varies from 54% opacity near the upper/lower edges to 68% at its center, with a 12-pixel feather. The gold halo follows the same inset rounded boundary, with a 4.5-pixel Gaussian falloff and maximum source alpha of 72%. Both fill the compact panel fitted to the active captions, below the icon/text group. This is geometric artwork preparation and does not execute addon code.

The runtime draws the full gold frame at 72 by 72 local units. The native square class icon occupies `72 * 55 / 103` units, offset `72 * 21 / 103` from the left and `72 * 17 / 103` from the top. These proportions reproduce the selected comparison's assembly; they are not claimed to be upstream atlas coordinates. The full native class-atlas quadrant remains visible under the frame.

The heading starts 72 units from the content group's left and 12 from its top, in DEFAULT 22 with outline and shadow. A shared text column fits the wider caption's natural glyph width plus four units. The DEFAULT 12 current-level caption anchors its top center to the heading's bottom center, two units below. The content group's width is 72 plus that column. The surrounding panel adds ten units of padding on each side and centers inside the existing visual bounds, removing the backdrop's unused locale allowance. Shared edit bounds still fit the widest supported heading and retain the existing 0.7 default visual scale and saved geometry.

The count badge starts at 20 by 20 local units. Its right edge anchors 68 units from the content group's left edge, with its top eight units below the group's top so the disk stays below the backdrop's upper border. Larger native counts widen the badge around the live DEFAULT 12 text. The halo and a duplicate gold-frame texture use additive blending, driven by one smooth 1.8-second cosine pulse on the visible button. Halo alpha varies from 0.25 to 0.9; frame-glow alpha varies from 0.1 to 0.5, with a 0.2 hover boost. Normal frame hiding stops the updater and resets its elapsed cosmetic time; the pulse continues while editing a visible active button. Ordinary legacy texture and anchor APIs handle all assets; no retail atlas or mask API is required.

Only the four used TGA files join `packaging/runtime-files.json`. Source sheets, comparison previews and preparation tools are excluded from the shipped payload. Static artwork inspection does not establish in-game rendering; local validation and addon/game execution remain unauthorized.
